reference_sql:
WITH order_line_counts AS (
  SELECT order_id, channel, COUNT(*) AS n_lines
  FROM sales
  GROUP BY order_id, channel
)
SELECT channel, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE n_lines > 1) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS multi_line_share
FROM order_line_counts
GROUP BY channel
alternatives: WITH order_line_counts AS (SELECT order_id, channel, COUNT(*) AS n_lines FROM sales GROUP BY order_id, channel) SELECT channel, AVG(CASE WHEN n_lines > 1 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS multi_line_share FROM order_line_counts GROUP BY channel

WITH c AS (SELECT order_id, channel, COUNT(order_line_id) AS n_lines FROM sales GROUP BY 1, 2) SELECT channel, SUM(CASE WHEN n_lines >= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS multi_line_share FROM c GROUP BY 1

other_way.sql: WITH order_line_counts AS (SELECT order_id, channel, COUNT(*) AS n_lines FROM sales GROUP BY order_id, channel) SELECT channel, AVG(CASE WHEN n_lines > 1 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS multi_line_share FROM order_line_counts GROUP BY channel
other_way.tradeoff: The average of a 1 or 0 flag gives the same share and runs in every dialect, while FILTER names the count you divide.

solver.query:
WITH per_order AS (
  SELECT order_id, channel, COUNT(*) AS n_lines
  FROM sales
  GROUP BY order_id, channel
)
SELECT channel, COUNT(CASE WHEN n_lines >= 2 THEN 1 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS multi_line_share
FROM per_order
GROUP BY channel
